scenarios.name: copies-colorless-spell-on-cast
scenarios.why: Echoes' own copy-trigger ('Whenever you cast a colorless spell, copy it') fires once -- 'another colorless permanent' excludes Echoes itself, and its copy puts a second Warping Wail on the stack, so the spell resolves twice and creates exactly two Eldrazi Scion tokens.

scenarios.name: doubles-colorless-cast-trigger
scenarios.why: Echoes is a Panharmonicon static over 'a triggered ability of a colorless spell you control or another colorless permanent you control': the World Breaker spell's own cast-trigger (WB is a colorless spell on the stack, CR 603.2c) triggers an additional time -- two exile triggers, one per artifact -- while Echoes' own trigger does NOT double ('Other' excludes it), so exactly two World Breakers end on the battlefield.
